title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
abstract: arXiv:2611.06043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. translated_title: Confucius4-R2T2：面向真·实时转录的稳定前缀流式语音识别模型
translated_abstract: 流式语音识别越来越多地被机器所消费，例如翻译器和语音代理，它们会在每个词元（token）出现时立即对其采取行动。一个稍后被修改的词元会导致已做工作的浪费或错误的行动。在这项工作中，我们提出了Confucius4-R2T2（Real Real-Time Transcription的缩写，即“真·实时转录”），这是一个稳定前缀的流式ASR模型，它在保持高准确率和低延迟的同时，从不修改其先前的输出。R2T2是通过对Qwen3-ASR-1.7B在1,500小时的中文和英文音频上进行后训练获得的，训练期间冻结了其预训练的音频编码器和投影器。这种适配基于最长稳定前缀（Longest Stable Prefix, LSP）的概念，这是我们在本工作中引入的一个新概念。我们证明了LSP在前缀序下单调，与完整音频的输出一致，并且在等于之前完整输出的标签中是最大的。从LSP标签进行学习，可以将一个全上下文模型转换为稳定前缀的流式模型，而无需任何架构上的改动。
tldr: 本文提出Confucius4-R2T2，一个基于新概念“最长稳定前缀（LSP）”的稳定前缀流式语音识别模型，通过对Qwen3-ASR-1.7B进行后训练，使其在保持高准确率和低延迟的同时从不修改先前输出，非常适合需要即时行动的机器消费场景。
